requirements.name: The transporter type decides which transporter record applies

scenarios.name: Choosing Commercial asks for a commercial transporter only

tests.test: commercial transporter is owed only for the commercial type and is wiped when the type changes
tests.notes: Commercial → select page; Private skips select and opens private details

tests.test: commercial branch selection routes to its address-book page
commercial in-scope, private out-of-scope when type is Commercial

scenarios.name: Choosing Private asks for private transporter details only

tests.test: keyed-in details are owed only for the private type; a partial fill blocks the save; changing the type wipes them
tests.notes: Private → details page; Commercial walks to select instead

tests.test: private branch selection routes to its details page and persists on back
Should walk the transport section, skipping the spokes the type gates out

requirements.name: Changing the transporter type discards the record the previous type called for

scenarios.name: Returning to Commercial shows no transporter selected

tests.test: commercial transporter is owed only for the commercial type and is wiped when the type changes
tests.notes: Commercial → save transporter → Private → Commercial: no radio checked on select

tests.test: purges a stored commercialTransporter address when type flips to Private

scenarios.name: Returning to Private shows an empty details form

tests.test: keyed-in details are owed only for the private type; a partial fill blocks the save; changing the type wipes them
tests.notes: Private → save details → Commercial → Private: name and country empty

tests.test: purges a stored privateTransporter address when type flips to Commercial
